newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were stable in late trading on Thursday with no new fresh leads to lift weak market sentiment, traders said.

"Demand is there in the market, albeit slow, but it does not change the bearish market sentiment at all. In fact, we expect offer prices to soften further tomorrow because we don't see any factors which can push the levels up," said one trader.
Traders said a deal was done in the afternoon at 45.375 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang for October shipment and at 45.00 for September shipment.
Offer prices were quoted at 45.50 fob Medan, 45.25 fob Surabaya, 45.00 fob Padang, 44.75 fob Jambi and 44.125 fob Pontianak, they said.
Traders said supply of raw material was getting better in a number of centres, and many tappers were still looking for other jobs because of the low rubber prices.
Some traders said they believed prices would rebound after it reachew the 44.00 U.S. cents/lb level.
